title: NIC & eCourts CoEE Roll Out AI Legal Assistant 'LegRAA' and 'Digital Courts 2.1'
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) AI assistant trained on 36,000 Supreme Court judgments assists judges.

blocks.content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) AI assistant trained on 36,000 Supreme Court judgments assists judges.

items: LegRAA Tool: Legal Research Analysis Assistant uses RAG architecture to analyze pleadings and generate case briefs.
Digital Courts 2.1: Includes voice-to-text dictation (ASR-SHRUTI) and translation (PANINI) under eCourts Phase-III.
Financial Allocation: Ministry of Law earmarked ₹53.57 crore for judicial AI tools.
